name: Box In
description: The first clip zooms out into a box, the box slides out of the frame, a box of the second clip slides in from the same side and zooms in to fill the frame. Drive `progress` from 0 to 1.

inputs.name: second
inputs.description: Incoming clip (same size as the first)

params.name: direction
params.description: Where the second box moves as it comes in: 0 left, 1 right, 2 up, 3 down (the first box leaves the opposite way, towards the side the second comes from)

params.name: box
params.description: Box size relative to the frame
